title: Clean HR VAE latent supervision, first paired single-seed study
teacher: frozen matched VAE posterior.mode, original channel normalization
head: single FP32 Linear1536to64; train-only
primary_quality_metric: clean x4 all33 RGB LPIPS Alex0.1, sampler mean within clip then equal32 clips
quality_interpretation: pairedclip95CI of baseline-minus-method LPIPS: lower>0 improvement; upper<=0 no benefit; otherwise insufficient; PSNR/SSIM/temporal tradeoffs always reported
selection: minimum final2048 validation mean LPIPS among two weights; exact ties choose .01; publish all attempts

uncertainty.interval: 95% linear-percentile descriptive conditional single training seed

efficiency: compare measured checkpoints against baseline final2048 LPIPS and synchronized cumulative training-step wall seconds; also report CUDA events, throughput, memory, full service wall time and checkpoint I/O separately

evaluation_scope.cohort: original sealed val32 with32 unique original source videos

test_policy: No new test access; historical test211 was evaluated by old models and is not a pristine project-wide test
resume_policy: same scientific protocol; verified full training checkpoint incl optimizer/head/RNG; preserve aborted attempts; do not count discarded updates as convergence progress
scope_end: this small-scale paired study and analysis; no multi-seed formal experiments or VAE intermediate-feature variants
